synthesis: The Missed Opportunities admin table reuses a single global Alpine disposition-popup component (mounted once via FilamentServiceProvider render hook, shared by Scans, Hits, Missed Op, and the map cluster-group views). Selecting a validation status (Valid/Reviewed/Invalid) persists the disposition correctly but never removes the row from the live DOM. Root cause (independently re-verified byte-for-byte): resources/js/app.js updateScanDisposition() only does the optimistic DOM removal `if (rowKey)`, and disposition-popup.blade.php changeDisposition(value) (line 90) — the code path every <select>-driven change takes — calls window.updateScanDisposition(this.modelId, value) with no rowKey, so the removal branch is skipped. The only call site that passes a rowKey is the separate 'Invalid Scan' reason-button grid (line 215). Missed-Op options never equal DispositionEnum::INVALID_SCAN, so a Missed-Op selection can never reach the working reason-button path. Persistence is unaffected; only the client-side row removal is missing.

scope.summary: Thread a null-guarded rowKey into changeDisposition()'s call to updateScanDisposition so the select-driven path also removes the row. The exact scoping (Missed-Op-only vs. all dispositions) and whether the backend default filter must widen depend on two material human decisions (see questions).

proposed_changes.change: In changeDisposition(value) at line 90, pass rowKey as the 4TH positional argument (reason 'other' stays 3rd) ONLY when this.missedOpportunity is true AND the selected value is the Invalid disposition (DispositionEnum::Invalid value). rowKey computed with a null-guard mirroring the server anchor id: 'scan-' + (this.rowLoop?.index ?? this.modelId). For Valid/Reviewed, or any non-missed-op table, pass no rowKey (behavior unchanged). Confirm the exact Invalid enum value from app/Enums/DispositionEnum.php during planning.
proposed_changes.reason: DECISION (Dalton 2026-07-24): scope Missed-Op-only, remove-on-Invalid-only. The missedOpportunity + Invalid gate keeps Scans/Hits unchanged and matches the backend default filter (excludes only Invalid), so no row vanishes live that the backend would return on refresh. 4th-arg placement avoids overwriting the server-validated `reason` param (422 + unintended ScanValidation record). Null-guard avoids a new TypeError on cluster-group views that pass no rowLoop.

proposed_changes.change: No functional change strictly required — the `if (rowKey)` guard already works once a truthy rowKey arrives. CONSIDER hardening the 4x-.parentElement climb to element.closest('tr') because MissedOpportunityResource is the only dispositionable table using Filament grouping (defaultGroup/collapsible), where the hop count was never validated. Decide during implement/QA.
proposed_changes.reason: The 4-hop removal was tuned against ungrouped Scans/Hits DOM; grouped MO rows may nest differently. Must be verified empirically in a browser (AC-1).

questions.q: SCOPE: Fix strictly to Missed Opportunity (gate the new rowKey on this.missedOpportunity), or apply to the shared changeDisposition() so every non-Invalid-Scan disposition change on Scans and Hits also removes its row?
questions.answer: Missed Opportunity only. Gate the new rowKey behind this.missedOpportunity so Scans/Hits dropdown behavior is unchanged.

questions.q: DATA SEMANTICS / AC-1 consistency: MissedOpportunity's default filter excludes ONLY Invalid, not Valid/Reviewed (pinned by MissedOpportunityResourceTest::test_default_view_excludes_only_invalid_dispositions). Optimistically removing Valid/Reviewed makes them vanish on click but reappear on refresh. (a) remove all three, (b) only remove on Invalid to match backend, or (c) widen the default filter to exclude Valid/Reviewed?
questions.answer: REVISED 2026-07-24 after QA. Original answer was 'only remove on Invalid', premised on the belief that the Missed-Op default view excludes only Invalid so Valid/Reviewed stay visible. QA disproved that premise: the default view is AWAITING-only (Filament passes [] for the unset filter → MissedOpportunityResource always runs forDispositions([]) = whereNull(disposition); the excludeDisposition(Invalid) branch is dead in the UI). Given that, Dalton chose to remove the row live on ANY disposition (Valid/Reviewed/Invalid) in missed-op mode — fully consistent with the awaiting-only reload behavior. Implementation: gate the rowKey on this.missedOpportunity only (dropped the value===Invalid check). Backend filter still UNCHANGED; the awaiting-only default-view behavior is pre-existing and filed separately if desired.

questions.q: Was any part of this row-removal path already touched by DEV-2176?
questions.answer: No. DEV-2176 (PR #261) only restored the SyncDispositionToClickhouse dispatch on app/Models/Scan.php + tests; it never touched app.js, disposition-popup.blade.php, or plate-images.blade.php. Confirmed via git log on all three files by 3 independent candidates.

notes: ARG-POSITION FOOTGUN (correctness-critical): updateScanDisposition(scan_id, disposition, reason='other', rowKey=null) in app.js. `reason` is the 3rd positional param, validated server-side against a fixed enum (ScanDispositionRequest: in:other,not a plate,plate too blurry,wrong ocr,wrong plate state) AND `reason !== 'other'` triggers creation of a ScanValidation record in Scan::updateDisposition. The rowKey MUST go in the 4th slot with 'other' explicitly in the 3rd — inserting rowKey as the 3rd arg 422s the request and breaks persistence.

NULL-GUARD: cluster-group.blade.php (scans + hits) @include plate-images WITHOUT a rowLoop prop (defaults to null). Client-side rowKey must be `this.rowLoop?.index ?? this.modelId`, mirroring the server-side `$id = $rowLoop?->index ?? $model_id` (plate-images.blade.php:22). The reporter's literal `'scan-'+this.rowLoop.index` would throw a TypeError there.

GROUPED-TABLE DOM RISK: MissedOpportunityResource is the ONLY dispositionable table using ->defaultGroup()/collapsible groups. The 4x .parentElement removal in app.js:111-113 was tuned against ungrouped Scans/Hits tables. The removal may fail or remove the wrong ancestor on the grouped MO DOM — MUST be verified in a real browser (this is what AC-1 hinges on). closest('tr') is a more robust alternative.

Exhaustiveness (agreed by all candidates): updateScanDisposition has exactly 2 call sites, both in disposition-popup.blade.php (line 90 buggy, line 215 rowKey-passing). The popup is shared globally by Scans (ListScans), Hits (HitsResource), Missed Op (MissedOpportunityResource), and both cluster-group views.

No JS/Dusk test runner in this repo — pin via a PHPUnit Blade-markup assertion (rendered plate-images/disposition-popup markup carries the rowKey-bearing call) + agent/manual browser QA for the actual DOM removal.
